The 2021 Macallan Limited Edition Classic Cut Single Malt Scotch Whisky is bottled at 102 Proof (51% ABV), the fifth release in the annual limited edition series from The Macallan Distillery in Craigellachie, Speyside. Since 2017, each Classic Cut has presented a single year's vatting at an elevated strength chosen to heighten its flavour, and the 2021 Edition, offered here in the 700ml format, delivers the gentlest strength the series had reached to that point, without sacrificing any intensity.

The Whisky Mastery Team crafted the 2021 Edition from an exquisite union of oak casks, pairing ex-bourbon American oak with The Macallan's renowned sherry seasoned American oak. The combination was designed to showcase the role of ex-bourbon casks within the portfolio, their sweet lightness set against the depth and complexity that sherry seasoning, carried out in Jerez, Spain, brings to American oak. The result is a new and uniquely heightened flavour experience within the series. Bottled without an age statement, it draws on casks chosen purely for the flavour they contribute.

Golden oak in colour, and 100% natural as with every Macallan, the 2021 Classic Cut announces itself with gingerbread, fruit jellies and marzipan, a confectionery-leaning profile that sets it apart from both the deep sherried editions of 2017 through 2019 and the vivid 55% bottling of 2020. At 51% ABV, the whisky keeps its full-strength concentration while remaining remarkably approachable in the glass.

Within the Classic Cut run, the 2021 Edition represents a refinement of the cask experimentation begun the previous year, an all-American-oak marriage that no other edition repeated in quite the same way. Because every Classic Cut is a one-time vatting, bottled once and retired, the 2021 release is a distinctive, softer-spoken chapter that collectors of the complete series will want represented alongside its bolder siblings. It also captures the series mid-journey, four editions after its 2017 debut, a snapshot of the Whisky Mastery Team exploring new territory.
